Name: VolcanoFarms
Author: Wandox99
Description:
[font=Arial][size=3]Hello Everyone!
This is the [i]VolcanoFarms[/i] mod.

[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=3][i]An underground Volcano has turned this land into an arid land, where plants cannot grow, will you be able to get something out of these lands anyway?
[/i]

[/size][/font][size=3][font=Arial]This mod change the Vanilla's FarmMap (Standard, Riverland, Forest, Mountain, Wilderness, Four Corner and the Beach) with Volcano Dungeon themed Maps.
For help you in this adventure, the mod change the Community Center Bundle, so [u]no crop is needed[/u].[/font]

For work, this mod require:
[i]SMAPI[/i] by [i]Pathoschild[/i];
[i]Content Patcher[/i] by [i]Pathoschild[/i];
[i]Farm Type Manage[/i]r by [i]Esca-MMC[/i].

The zip file has 5 folder inside:
[CP]VolcanoFarm;
[CP]VolcanoFarm_Minimap;
[CP]VolcanoFarm_intro_UI;
[FTM] VolcanoFarm_DailySpawn;
[FTM] VolcanoFarm_FirstSetup;
You need all of them when you are creating a new Farm for a "full experience".

[b]For avoid bug or glitch: Do not use old save with this mods.[/b]

For more details, I've writed a README.txt inside [CP]VolcanoFarm mod folder.


[size=4]If you liked the mod, please leave an endorsement![/size]



If you have suggestion or feedback feel free to write me on the [url=http://discord.gg/stardewvalley]official Discord server[/url] with the tag @Wandox#6064 in the modmaking channels
